breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the standard flexure formula σ = (M * y) / I, which produces a linear stress distribution. It correctly computes zero stress at the neutral axis (y = 0 mm), compression at the top fiber, and tension at the bottom fiber. The incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt — treating bending stress as uniform over the section depth — was not followed. The agent properly ignored that erroneous instruction and aligned with the ground truth.
